{{Top|leg}}
{{Quote|I hired a talented artist to sculpt a bantha out of a piece of kiliad marble.|[[Vardias Tyne]]|<ref name="SWG">{{GalaxiesAED}}</ref>}}
'''Kiliad marble''' was a type of [[Marble/Legends|marble]].

==History==
[[File:BanthaStatue.jpg|thumb|left|150px|A small [[Bantha/Legends|bantha]] statue, sculpted out of kiliad [[Marble/Legends|marble]].]]
{{GameMechanics|legends=1}}
During [[1 ABY/Legends|1.5 ABY]], an [[Anchorhead/Legends|Anchorhead]] resident named [[Vardias Tyne]] had an [[Artist/Legends|artist]] sculpt a [[Bantha/Legends|bantha]] statue out of kiliad [[Marble/Legends|marble]]. He had a [[Spacer/Legends|spacer]] deliver the bantha statue to Brother [[Chonar]] of the [[Dim-U/Legends|Dim-U]] monks, as forgiveness for killing a bantha that was attacking his [[Moisture vaporator/Legends|vaporators]]. Upon receiving the statue, Chonar claimed that the gift conveyed the respect for the majesty of banthas.<ref name="SWG" />
{{Endgame}}[[Jabba Desilijic Tiure|Jabba the Hutt's]] throne aboard his [[Sail barge/Legends|sail barge]], the ''[[Khetanna/Legends|Khetanna]]'', was made of Kiliad marble.<ref name="GG5">''[[Galaxy Guide 5: Return of the Jedi]]''</ref>

==Behind the scenes==
[[Vardias Tyne]] was a [[Wikipedia:Non-player character|Non-Player Character]] (NPC) in the [[Wikipedia:Massively multiplayer online role-playing game|MMORPG]] [[Star Wars Galaxies|''Star Wars Galaxies: An Empire Divided'']]. Players who performed a series of [[:w:c:swg:Quest|quests]] for Vardias in [[Anchorhead/Legends|Anchorhead]] had to deliver a [[Bantha/Legends|bantha]] statue to [[Chonar]]. In the quest dialogue, Vardias Tyne mentioned that the bantha statue was made out of a piece of kiliad [[Marble/Legends|marble]]. Although the player could choose not to do Vardias Tyne's quests, this article assumes 100% game completion.<ref name="SWG" />
